evidence_digest: Runtime launch paths record APP_START_FAILED but can replace the thrown failure with CLOSE_FAILED when artifact cleanup fails. ArtifactStore quarantines non-retained sessions when no identity-bound deleter is supplied, while default runtime artifact creation supplies none, leaving empty proving-run quarantine residue. Existing tests do not cover the combined real managed-launch failure path, original-failure preservation with cleanup failure, or empty-session convergence.
